name: comp-578
title: Mega Menu Navbar
blurb: Mega menu navbar with icon, description, and simple submenu types.
description: Responsive header with desktop mega menu (descriptions/icons/simple items) and mobile popover. Collapses cleanly at breakpoint.
use_when: You need multi-level navigation with mixed content types (descriptions, icons, simple links) in a compact header.
avoid_when: Simple linear navigation; mega menus add complexity and desk space.
a11y: Keyboard-navigable nav menu. Mobile menu managed with aria-expanded. Links are semantic.
